bullets_en: Deepam row: SC agrees to hear contempt pleas, applications on Nov 27.
Women refuse to attend Revanth Reddy’s public meeting in Nagarkurnool’s Achampet.
Terrorist wanted for cop's murder arrested in J&K after 20 years on the run.
At least 13 dead in Indonesia gold mine flood as rescue efforts intensify.
Kerala Woman Out On Bail In Drug Cases Attacks Excise Officer During Raid.
bullets_ur: Deepam tanaza: SC 27 November ko toheen-e-adalat ki darkhwaston par samaat ke liye raazi.
Nagarkurnool ke Achampet mein khawateen ka Revanth Reddy ke jalsay mein shirkat se inkar.
Police ahlkar ke qatal mein matloob dehshatgard 20 saal farar rehne ke baad J&K mein giraftar.
At least 13 ki maut ho gayi.
Manshiyat cases mein zamant par riha Kerala ki khatoon ka raid ke doran Excise Officer par hamla.
